result.title: FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention
result.summary: Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FON，把同一权重栈分化为「起草器官」（可学习多抽头延迟 + 内容自适应递归，因果、O(S) 训练、O(1) 解码状态）与「修订器官」（通过多尺度 ripple 核与弱门控重处理已写前缀、不产生输出），在 30M/70M 规模上报告 WikiText-103 困惑度、长度外推与域内 infilling 的收益与代价。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本生成架构，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「生成通道 vs 非生成式修订通道」的双器官划分、可学习延迟递归与弱门控回读前缀，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新与验证/修正通路设计提供借鉴线索，可供核查其 O(1) 状态与递归机制能否迁移。
